title: We built a project-aware AI assistant for Unity
author: EnvironmentalFox7198
selftext:
Hey folks,

Over the past few months we’ve been building an AI assistant for Unity to help with one of the most time-consuming parts of game development: understanding and evolving large projects where scripts, scenes, and prefabs are tightly connected.

Instead of focusing on single “generate a script” prompts, the assistant works inside the project and keeps context across multiple steps.

Some of the things it can do right now:

* Generate and modify scripts with awareness of the existing codebase
* Manage objects directly in a Unity scene
* Create and update prefabs, materials, and shaders
* Track multi-step changes and refactors instead of isolated edits

We’ve been sharing short, practical demos that show how the assistant works by building small Unity projects from scratch, step by step.

**YouTube:**

[https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC2Ua8pu\_pMpYiutw0pLqGrQ](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC2Ua8pu_pMpYiutw0pLqGrQ)

If anyone wants to explore the tool itself, here’s the project:

[https://ludosai.com/](https://ludosai.com/)

We’d love to hear how others here are approaching AI tooling inside real game pipelines and what’s been most useful (or disappointing) in practice.
